import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem sprint_development_0105 {α : Type*} {β : Type*} {γ : Type*} (s : Finset α) (t : Finset β) (u : Finset γ) (h1 : s.disjoint t) (h2 : (s ∪ t).disjoint u) : s.disjoint u := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem sprint_development_0105 {α : Type*} {β : Type*} {γ : Type*} (s : Finset α) (t : Finset β) (u : Finset γ) (h1 : s.disjoint t) (h2 : (s ∪ t).disjoint u) : s.disjoint u :=
  h2.1
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.sprint_development_0105 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0105 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0105

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.sprint_development_0105
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0105
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
